title: I feel like a made a really fun and addictive PVP RTS game
author: Transhumanliberal
selftext:
Hello!

I made this RTS game with POV "hero" mode with Opus 5..5 in a couple of days (due to usage limits) and I feel like it's actually very fun to paly. I played about 30-40 1v1 games with a friend and would love a couple of new players and some feedback, and potentially someone to challenge me 1v1. The mechanics seem to be quite balanced and the units have interesting and unique interactions. If anyone's interested in giving it a try, here's the game - [https://dharma.rocks/rts](https://dharma.rocks/rts)

There are currently 2 maps and 2 ancient civs with unique units and mechanics.
